decision: Both transport prototypes rejected; production read transport remains REST.
reproduction: Apply the selected tracked patch to the base revision, then copy its corresponding reads.rs file to src/grpc_reads.rs. Build before timing. For each prototype use the same image for REST and opt-in runs; unset QDRANT_GRPC_URL for REST, or set it to the Qdrant gRPC service on port 6334. Preserve corpus and caps. Run REST,opt-in,opt-in,REST with TRACK_TOTAL_HITS=true REQUESTS=200 TRIALS=3 WARMUP=40 using compare_reads.py.
measurement_notes: All eight paired rounds use exact totals and strict response checks, including sources, sort values and buckets. Each prototype contributes 72000 measured responses.
Transport provenance grpc_opt_in identifies all-read gRPC in the full prototype and get/scroll/facet gRPC with REST counts in the hybrid prototype. Writes remain REST.
Each round records image IDs and resource limits. No builds, tests or ingestion ran during timing.
A separately retained disabled-total REST-only diagnostic is not a paired comparison and is excluded from summaries and the 144000-response paired count.
